models_evaluated: public pulmonary TB chest radiograph classifier (baseline)
locally adapted TB chest radiograph classifier

links.outcome: Discrimination of locally adapted vs public baseline TB classifier on held-out set
links.effect: Adapted held-out ROC AUC 0.9902; paired AUC difference from public baseline 0.0054 (95% CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864), no statistical superiority.
links.quote: The paired AUC difference from the public baseline was 0.0054 (95 % CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864), showing no statistical superiority.

links.outcome: Site-stratified AUC performance of adapted model at two sites
links.effect: Adapted held-out AUCs were 0.9844 at the District Hospital and 0.9973 at the TB Dispensary; site-stratified internal estimates, not institution-held-out validation.
links.quote: Adapted held-out AUCs were 0.9844 (0.9375-1.0000) at the District Hospital and 0.9973 (0.9841-1.0000) at the TB Dispensary; these were site-stratified internal estimates, not institution-held-out validation.

models_evaluated: locally adapted public pulmonary tuberculosis classifier

links.outcome: Adapted model versus public baseline AUC
links.effect: AUC difference from public baseline was 0.0054 (95% CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864), showing no statistical superiority.
links.quote: The paired AUC difference from the public baseline was 0.0054 (95 % CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864), showing no statistical superiority.
On the primary held-out subset (n = 76; 15 TB-positive), the adapted model achieved ROC AUC 0.9902 (95 % CI 0.9694-1.0000), F1 0.9375 (0.8571-1.0000), and precision-recall AUC 0.9557 (0.8717-1.0000).

links.effect: District Hospital AUC 0.9844 (0.9375-1.0000); TB Dispensary AUC 0.9973 (0.9841-1.0000); site-stratified internal, not institution-held-out.
links.quote: Adapted held-out AUCs were 0.9844 (0.9375-1.0000) at the District Hospital and 0.9973 (0.9841-1.0000) at the TB Dispensary; these were site-stratified internal estimates, not institution-held-out validation.

links.outcome: tuberculosis detection discrimination difference after local adaptation
links.effect: paired AUC difference 0.0054 (95% CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864)
links.quote: The paired AUC difference from the public baseline was 0.0054 (95 % CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864), showing no statistical superiority.
